title: Monero GUI wallets
whyItMatters: Monero wallet files and keys. Anyone with them and the password can move the funds.
source: Monero documentation, monero-wallet-gui reference (defaults): wallets are created under $HOME/Monero/wallets
notes: The wizard can place wallets elsewhere; only the default is checked. Reviewed in W3-D2 (independent review, docs/research/macos-review.md).
